Turner]] |asst_coach2=Shawn Forrest |asst_coach3=Jay Duncan |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[Moody Coliseum]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team''' represented [[Southern Methodist University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mustangs were led by second-year head coach [[Tim Jankovich]] and played their home games at [[Moody Coliseum]] on their campus in [[University Park, Texas]] as members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 17–16, 6–12 in [[2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in ninth place. In the [[2018 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]] before losing to [[2017–18 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] in the quarterfinals. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|Mustangs]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 30–5, 17–1 in [[2016–17 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to win the AAC regular season championship. In the [[2017 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 East Carolina Pirates men's basketball team|East Carolina]],{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400945786|title=East Carolina vs. SMU – Game Recap – March 10, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-07-31}} [[2016–17 UCF Knights men's basketball team|UCF]],{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400946251|title=UCF vs. SMU – Game Recap – March 11, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-07-31}} and [[2016–17 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] to win the tournament championship.{{Cite news|url=http://www.nhregister.com/sports/20170312/smu-beats-cincinnati-for-aac-championship|title=SMU beats Cincinnati for AAC championship|access-date=2017-07-31|language=en}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400946312|title=Cincinnati vs. SMU – Game Recap – March 12, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-07-31}} As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As the No. 6 seed in the East region, were upset in the first round by No. 11 [[2016–17 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC]].{{Cite news|url=https://sportsday.dallasnews.com/college-sports/smumustangs/2017/03/17/gone-60-seconds-smu-left-heartbreak-final-minute-loss-usc|title=Gone in 60 seconds: SMU left with only heartbreak after final minute of loss to USC|date=2017-03-17|work=SportsDay|access-date=2017-07-31|language=en}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.sbnation.com/college-basketball/2017/3/17/14959390/usc-smu-ncaa-tournament-final-score-2017|title=SMU's game-winning drive came up just short vs. USC|work=SBNation.com|access-date=2017-07-31}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
